title: Make / made / made
descriptionFa: عبارت‌هایی که با make می‌گیم (نه do)، و make me feel.

words.example: My grandmother made this carpet by hand.
words.tipFa: make / made / made. ساخت جایی: Made in Iran.

words.example: Shall I make tea for everyone?
words.tipFa: make coffee / hot chocolate هم همین‌طور.

words.example: It's my turn to make dinner tonight.
words.tipFa: make breakfast / lunch هم می‌گیم. ولی «خوردن»ش have هست: have dinner.

words.example: Can you make a photocopy of this page?
words.tipFa: ولی عکس گرفتن: take a photo، نه make a photo.

words.example: She wants to make a film about her village.
Rainy days make me feel sleepy.
words.tipFa: feel رو می‌شه حذف کرد: That film made me sad.

words.example: Don't worry if you make a mistake. It's how we learn.
words.tipFa: make a mistake، نه do a mistake.

words.example: I need to make an appointment with the dentist.
I make the bed every morning after I get up.
words.tipFa: با ضمیر: make my bed, make your bed.

words.example: Please don't make a noise. The baby is sleeping.
The kids always make a mess when they cook.
It's difficult, but you have to make a choice.
words.tipFa: تصمیم گرفتن هم با make: make a decision.
